description: Provenance of the contract copies bundled with this jar. Two kinds of entry, on purpose: 'files' are frozen copies of FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification RELEASE tags (governed by selection rules V1-V4), and 'drafts' are unreleased development contracts read only through the rule V7 opt-in lane. Each entry records the source repository, the commit, the exact path, the SHA-256 of the bytes and the retrieval date; the family convention is that a copied tree is pinned by commit and digest together. CapabilityTest and DraftProvenanceTest re-compute every digest on every build, so a copy that drifts from its own provenance fails the build instead of quietly becoming someone else's bytes.
releaseAndBytesAreSeparateAxes: A release tag says which registry row a file answers to; a digest says which bytes it is. They are recorded apart because they do not coincide: releases v0.4.1 and v0.4.2 changed no contract, so they repeat the v0.4.0 bytes, and v0.6.0's fhr.json is the unchanged v0.5.0 bytes (FHR 2.1 did not move). The 'releases' map in schemas/bundled.json therefore points several releases at one frozen copy, and each copy is named once here.

identicalBytesAcrossTags.v0.4.1/v0.4.2 fhr|fhp|fhgff3: v0.4.0 same files (verified with cmp on 2026-11-14)

artifacts.role: the draft file-bound header contract (rules V7, C1-C3 of the FHT suite)

suitePinAnnotation.note: Advisory measurements, recorded beside the pin but never a substitute for it: the suite is pinned by digest first and count second. A count-only assertion cannot see drift that does not move the count.
suitePinAnnotation.delta: 66 -> 72 vectors (all format fht-fasta): 2 gzip-framing vectors (multi-member split, compressed sequence tamper) and 4 real-data promotion candidates from pilot #45 that the suite itself marks promotion=candidate-unreviewed; the contract bytes fht.json did not move.
suitePinAnnotation.resolution: be9bcc825f55db92852fd882ffba4c1c214f53db resolves both ways: it is FHT-Specification origin/main on 2026-11-15 and the last commit that touched conformance/manifest.json. Measured from the content-addressed blob (git show), not from raw.githubusercontent.com.

FHT.crossCheck: The pinned contract commit is unchanged: the 226f923c blob was re-measured on 2026-11-15 (git show, 29 430 bytes, sha256 59ad9641adcb0e5591045c2d894c066d1adc9984cca84c5ff6502f8dad88487e) and cmp-matches origin/main's fht.json at suite commit be9bcc82 - the contract record stays where it is; only the suite record advanced. The reference toolkit pins the same contract commit and digest (FAIR-bioHeaders-Tools bioheaders/schemas/bundled.json, its #154 re-pin), verified 2026-11-14. The contract bytes live in this jar; the vectors come from the suite revision above, and DraftHarness re-digests both against these values before reading a vector.
FHT.meaning: Unreleased development contract, readable only through the rule V7 opt-in lane and warned on for every record read that way. Not a released contract: no schemaVersion row in the shared schemas/versions.json, no w3id alias, no release tag, no support claim. Publication moves it out of the lane (FHT is scheduled as specification v0.7.0).

transport.note: FHGM records are not a file header. They ride inside an FHGFF3 header under one R15 extension key, so the lane needs two pinned files - the record contract and the transport overlay - each with its own commit and digest, and the file itself is still routed by its own released FHGFF3 citation under V1-V3. A records row without all five transport fields (transportFile, transportSha256, transportCommit, modelsKey, carrierFileKey) is refused at registry load.

artifacts.role: transport overlay (the suite's K1): admits either released FHGFF3 file identity as a closed branch (v0.5.0 URI set + schemaVersion 1.1, or v0.6.0 URI set + schemaVersion 1.2) plus the non-empty x-fhgm-models array; superseded dd9f69274f26860bbfd71d0e8b2794420c5369fb5d40ce838fb6a9e6d5116e3d (1 363 B), the 1.1-only pin from 2026-11-14

baseSchemas.note: Shape copied from the owning repository's own base registry (FHGM-Specification development/model/base-schemas.json, registryVersion 1, measured at suite commit 57118c52 as sha256 33f3fd541fe6ad611376a559279a0f95a5b7901418a6e1e44aebc78f9a47370f): every base is keyed by the SHA-256 of the exact release bytes, resolves its tag to a commit (and names the annotated-tag object), and never records a floating branch for released material. DraftProvenanceTest checks each digest against this jar's frozen copy from 'files' and each commit against tagCommits above.
baseSchemas.selectionRule: A carrier declares its base through its own released file identity (schema URI plus schemaVersion); rules V1-V3 route it and the overlay's closed branches admit exactly that pairing. An unsupported declared version with no registered base is refused, not substituted.

bases.commitNote: The commit the v0.5.0 annotated tag names; it is not an ancestor of shared main (the pre-merge-tag split recorded in the workspace guide). Verified 2026-11-15 by git rev-parse v0.5.0 v0.5.0^{commit} in a fetched checkout of FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification.
bases.role: sealed lane: every expectation in the pinned manifest.json (the 43 sealed vectors) was observed against these bytes

bases.commitNote: The commit the v0.6.0 annotated tag names; unlike v0.5.0 it is an ancestor of shared main. Verified 2026-11-15 by git rev-parse in the same checkout.
bases.role: matrix lane: the suite's separate development/conformance/base_matrix.json re-observes identity-rewritten 1.2 twins against these bytes. This library's draft job runs the sealed manifest.json only; the matrix lane is NOT run here and is reported not-run with this reason, never absorbed into the 43.

suitePinAnnotation.note: Advisory measurements beside the pin; the suite is pinned by digest first and count second. This very suite is the proof: its manifest passed through 36 001 bytes at 5d15ccc1 with the vector count STILL 31 on the way to 51 114 bytes / 43 vectors - a count-only assertion would have reported that step as no drift at all (measured 2026-11-15 from git log over the manifest's own history).
suitePinAnnotation.delta: 31 -> 43 vectors: the 12 promoted dmel-* real-data cases (GCF_000001215.4 chr4 fixtures under development/examples/dmel4/, sealed at d443073a, 'expectations require independent review' per the commit); 14 valid / 29 invalid; all 39 files the manifest references exist at the pinned suite commit (checked with git cat-file -e).
suitePinAnnotation.resolution: 57118c52363990dcaa42640394db84acb089cc24 is FHGM-Specification origin/main on 2026-11-15; the last commit that touched development/conformance/manifest.json is d443073a, and 57118c52 only re-recorded the checker digest in the suite's own provenance.json - manifest, record contract, overlay and base registry are byte-identical at both (measured). The record-contract commit and the suite commit are deliberately separate fields: contract pin is not suite pin.

FHGM.crossCheck: Re-measured 2026-11-15 from content-addressed blobs (git show, not raw URLs): the record contract at ac3d37b3 and at origin/main (57118c52) are the same 9 564-byte blob (bf1553ca...), so its record stays; the overlay moved from dd9f6927... (1 363 B) to d1619cce... (2 613 B) at 5d15ccc1 when FHGM-Specification #17 made the transport dual-base, and the shipped copy in this jar was cmp-verified against the 57118c52 blob. The two base releases were independently re-resolved in a fetched FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification checkout (tag objects, commits, sizes and digests above match this jar's frozen fhgff3-1.1/fhgff3-1.2 copies and FHGM's own base-schemas.json). The suite's own development/conformance/provenance.json records the same artifact digests, so the pins agree across repositories without either one trusting the other's prose.
FHGM.meaning: Unreleased development contracts for gene-model records, readable only through the rule V7 opt-in lane and warned on per record. Not a released contract and not a file-bound header type: no schemaVersion, no w3id alias, no shared registry row, no support claim. Publication is scheduled separately (specification v0.8.0).
